method: Reviewed current official pytest plugin discovery, npm scripts/lifecycle, Cargo build scripts, Docker Engine security, pip secure installs, and Python subprocess security documentation. Ran the W6 verifier: it compiles and executes the policy data model, then creates a fresh temporary directory/venv and installs only the hash-pinned pytest 8.4.2 dependency set before running a one-test fixture. PYTEST_DISABLE_PLUGIN_AUTOLOAD=1 disables external plugin autoload; the local conftest.py still writes the marker during collection. The earlier direct smoke run confirmed pytest 8.4.2; the verifier rerun passed 25/25. No provider calls; dependency retrieval may use PyPI. Production build generated 404 static pages; Pagefind indexed 404 pages / 15,467 words. Light/dark full-page captures output/playwright/coding-agent-safety-w6-20261022-{light,dark}.png are 1300×6,784; article=792px, document width=1300px, one Mermaid SVG rendered; the only console error is the existing favicon 404.
limitations: This reproduces the conftest import side effect under pytest 8.4.2 and Python 3.14.7 only; it does not recover or replay the original 2026-10-10 environment, exact logs, or full historical repo.
No real sandbox, container escape, host credential exposure, DNS/proxy enforcement, package provenance, production authorization, or human approval service was tested.
The policy object remains illustrative data; it performs no isolation or command execution.
